::: {#rem-complement-notation}
#### The universal set, and other notation for the complement

The set $S$ in @def-complement is sometimes called the *universal set*.
Which universal set to use depends on the context:
for a set of even integers it might be $\mathbb{Z}$,
and for a set of letters it might be the 26 letters of the alphabet.
Some sources write $\overline{A}$ for $A^c$
[@wikipedia_complement_set_theory].

:::
